svg.title: Bathroom Safety Monitoring System Pipeline
svg.desc: End-to-end implementation pipeline from camera setup to emergency notification for elderly bathroom safety monitoring

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain camera placement strategy for bathroom door entry/exit detection without invading privacy')
g.text: CCTV camera placed at door frame (outside only), capturing entry/exit zone

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What kind of dataset should I collect for bathroom entry/exit detection?')
g.text: Record entry/exit events, label bounding boxes, annotate person presence & direction

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What preprocessing steps are needed for video-based entry/exit detection?')
g.text: Frame extraction, resizing, normalization, background subtraction, augmentation

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Which deep learning model is best for detecting entry and exit events at a doorway?')
g.text: Detect person, classify direction (entry/exit), real-time inference on edge device

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I implement the entry and exit event logic with timestamps?')
g.text: Log entry_time on detection, record exit_time on exit event, compute duration

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should I determine the safe time threshold for elderly bathroom stays?')
g.text: Compare elapsed time vs safe threshold (configurable), trigger flag if exceeded

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I implement the emergency notification system for the bathroom safety monitor?')
g.text: Trigger alarm (buzzer/app), send SMS or push notification to caregiver

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What data should I log for the bathroom safety monitoring system?')
g.text: Store event logs, visualize duration history, admin panel for threshold config

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I evaluate the performance of the bathroom safety monitoring system?')
g.text: Measure detection accuracy, false alarm rate, latency; user testing with caregivers
